Many speculate that these representations encode a continuous analogue of discrete linguistic properties, e.g., part-of-speech tags, due to the networks’ impressive performance on many NLP tasks (Belinkov et al. 2017).

As a result of this speculation, one common thread of research focuses on the construction of probes, i.e., supervised models that are trained to extract the linguistic properties directly (Belinkov et al. 2017; Conneau et al. 2018; Peters et al. 2018b; Zhang and Bowman 2018; Naik et al. 2018; Tenney et al. 2019).
